messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile/tablet-friendly 3D RPG with a hero, story and dungeon modes, monarch and villain battles, leveling, and magic weapons.

## Requirements
- User requested: “I want a game that role playing, a main hero where dungeons and story mode available, after defeating the monarchs and villains hero get level up and get new daggers, weapons with magic abilities (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)”
- Build the game without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained HTML canvas game with a custom low-poly 3D perspective renderer, rather than external 3D dependencies.
- Added Story Mode and Dungeon Run, touch and keyboard controls, enemy encounters, magic attacks, leveling, and weapon upgrades.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` containing the game, UI, renderer, controls, combat, and progression.
- Added responsive layouts and mobile touch joystick/action buttons.
- Checked JavaScript syntax with `node --check`.
- Started a local server and inspected desktop and mobile screenshots; corrected the menu/HUD visibility and mobile scene issue.

### Active
- Final verification and any remaining gameplay/rendering polish.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the latest `index.html` and current screenshot/game behavior; fix any issues found.
2. Run a gameplay smoke test covering both modes, combat, leveling, weapon unlocks, boss completion, and mobile controls.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `screenshots/ashen-mobile-game.jpg`: Latest captured mobile gameplay screenshot.
